test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The data which she presented was the most latest one on the matter under discussion.
solution:
The correct answer is 'was the most latest one.'

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The part **'****was the most latest one'** is incorrect as it is grammatically incorrect.
 
• A common mistake with double superlatives is using both the ending** -est **and the word** “most” **in the same sentence.
 
 
• **Example**: *Justin is the most fastest runner on the track team.

 Justin is the fastest runner on the track team.*
 
 
 
• It would be best to remove** “most” **and keep **latest** in the superlative degree.
 
• *​*Therefore, the use of 'was the most latest one' in the sentence should be replaced with 'was the latest one' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is 'was the most latest one.'
 
• ​​The correct sentence__: *The data which she presented was **the latest one** on the matter under discussion.*

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• The meaning of the adjective 'latest' is of most recent date.

 
 
• Example: We are covering the **latest** news.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• भाग 'was the most latest one' गलत है क्योंकि यह व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है।
 
• Double superlatives के साथ एक सामान्य गलती एक ही वाक्य में अंतिम **-est **और **"most"** शब्द दोनों का उपयोग कर रही है।
 
 
• Example: *Justin is the most fastest runner on the track team.

 Justin is the fastest runner on the track team.*
 
 
 
• **"Most"** को हटाना और superlative degree में **latest** रखना सबसे अच्छा होगा।
 
• इसलिए, व्याकरण की दृष्टि से इसे सही बनाने के लिए वाक्य में 'was the most latest one' के उपयोग को 'was the latest one' से बदल दिया जाना चाहिए।
